definitions.gloss: standpoint; viewpoint; perspective from which to consider something
definitions.explanation: The position or angle from which one considers an issue. Used in formal contexts to indicate the framework or set of values guiding analysis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I explained it from a legal standpoint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: From an educational standpoint, this system has many problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長期的|ちょうきてき}→長期的：20406_choukiteki⟧な{見地|けんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to make a judgment from a long-term perspective.

notes:
Formal; common in academic, legal, business, and policy discussion. Most often appears in the patterns ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ ("from the standpoint of ~") and ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ ("to take the standpoint of ~").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the standpoint of ~
- {見地|けんち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to take the standpoint
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見地|けんち}: legal standpoint
- ⟦{長期的|ちょうきてき}→長期的：20406_choukiteki⟧な{見地|けんち}: long-term perspective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{観点|かんてん}→観点：05582_kanten⟧: viewpoint — very close in meaning and more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: position; standpoint — emphasizes one's social role or situation rather than analytical framework
- ⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧: viewpoint; angle — focuses on where one's eyes are placed, more literal/visual
